payload.body: hv asked dc whether to run route C's opt step (bin/devbin install, bin/devbin use opt) now. dc advised waiting until the cut is next, and hv said they will wait for vc's word. Reasons, for the cut's steps: after use opt, use brew refuses the 0.1.8 keg (devbin 0348), so until 0.1.9's keg every ccusage, Molt's ccusage dir included, would be main's unreleased build against hv's real config; and install publishes main as it stands, so it is redone at the cut anyway. The way back before 0.1.9 is to remove the ~/.local/bin/ccusage link by hand, which falls back to Homebrew's 0.1.8 on PATH.
